2608.14906.title: Optimal Watermark Localization in Mixed-Source Large Language Model Texts
2608.14906.paper_summary: Watermarking provides a principled way to authenticate text generated by large language models (LLMs). In practice, however, the final text may be mixed-source, with watermark evidence surviving at only a subset of token positions after rewriting, insertion, deletion, or paraphrasing. Although prior work has studied global detection of watermark signals, when such signals can be localized remains unclear. We formulate watermark localization as a token-level multiple-testing problem based on pivotal statistics, with a latent indicator recording whether watermark dependence survives at each position. Under an asymptotic regime indexed by exponents for signal sparsity, next-token concentration, and effective-vocabulary growth, we derive a sharp boundary for global detection and phase transitions for discovery and classification within the class of coordinatewise pivot-based localization rules. We show that discovery is strictly harder than detection and that consistent classification is impossible across the parameter regime within this class. We then develop an adaptive thresholding method that does not require knowledge of the exponents or time-varying next-token distributions, but uses a data-driven estimate of the surviving watermark fraction. The method attains the optimal discovery boundary and near-optimal discovery power relative to homogeneous pivot-based rules. Simulations support the theoretical phase transitions, while experiments on model-generated texts demonstrate practical localization performance under common edit mechanisms.
2608.14906.paper_summary_zh: 水印技術提供了一種原則性的方法來驗證由大型語言模型（LLMs）生成的文本。<lb/>然而，在實際操作中，最終文本可能是混合來源的，水印證據在重寫、插入、刪除或改寫後僅在部分標記位置存活。<lb/>儘管先前的研究已經探討了水印信號的全局檢測，但何時能夠對這些信號進行定位仍然不清楚。<lb/>我們將水印定位公式化為基於關鍵統計的標記級多重測試問題，並設置潛在指標來記錄每個位置是否存活著水印依賴。<lb/>在由信號稀疏性、下一標記集中度和有效詞彙增長的指數索引的漸近範疇下，我們推導出全局檢測的明確邊界，以及在坐標基於樞紐定位規則類別內的發現和分類的相變。<lb/>我們顯示發現比檢測要難得多，並且在這個類別的參數範疇內，持續分類是不可能的。<lb/>然後，我們開發了一種自適應閾值方法，該方法不需要了解指數或隨時間變化的下一標記分佈，而是使用對存活水印比例的數據驅動估計。<lb/>該方法達到了最佳的發現邊界，並相對於均質樞紐基準則達到了近乎最佳的發現能力。<lb/>模擬支持理論相變，而對模型生成文本的實驗則展示了在常見編輯機制下的實際定位性能。
